decision_rule.H2: robust positive control adequate all widths; A and B false; at least one integrated-width relevance or Bonferroni-corrected horizon-specific relevance
decision_rule.Outcome_A: robust positive control adequate all widths AND lower 95% CI of median(I_weak-I_fiber) > SESOI in all widths
decision_rule.Outcome_B: robust positive control adequate all widths AND upper 95% CI of median(abs(I_weak-I_fiber)) < SESOI in all widths AND no horizon-specific weak relevance in any width
decision_rule.Outcome_C: positive control inadequate OR weak/fiber remains unresolved under the frozen rules
decision_rule.SESOI: per width/horizon = 0.05 * median robust-minus-fiber effect at the same summary/horizon; formula frozen prospectively
